title: American Library Association launches national advocacy campaign to fight FCC attack on library funding

title: Laufey takes center stage as honorary chair of Library Card Sign-up Month 2026
content: <span class="field field--name-title field--type-string field--label-hidden">Laufey takes center stage as honorary chair of Library Card Sign-up Month 2026</span> <div class="clearfix text-formatted field field--name-body field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field__item"><!DOCTYPE html> <html><body><div> <p>CHICAGO – Icelandic-Chinese composer, singer, producer, and multi-instrumentalist Laufey has been named honorary chair of Library Card Sign-up Month. This September, Laufey will join the American Library Association (ALA) and libraries nationwide to give everyone a front row seat to the joy of getting a library card.</p> </div> <div> <p>“Laufey’s ability to connect with fans around the world makes her an inspiring champion for libraries and the transformative power of a library card,” said ALA President Sam Helmick. “Her passion for reading, creativity, and community mirrors the heart of what libraries stand for.”</p> </div> <div> <p>As honorary chair, Laufey will spotlight how, no matter what your tastes are, a library card hits all the right notes—whether you enjoy reading a classic story, vibing out in a cozy nook,
